req.title: Update existing post
req.statement: The system shall update the row when POST /<id>/update is called by the post's author with a title and body, and redirect to /.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that the system should update a post when the correct endpoint is called by the post's author with valid data. The test suite includes a positive test to verify successful update, a negative test to check unauthorized access, and a boundary test to ensure the system handles empty titles correctly.

tests.name: test_update_post_success
preconditions: Post with id 1 exists and is authored by 'test'
actions: Send POST request to '/1/update' with valid title and body
expected: Post is updated with new title and body
tests.executable:
from flaskr import create_app
import tempfile, os
fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(); os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
client = app.test_client()
client.post('/auth/login', data={'username': 'test', 'password': 'test'})
r = client.post('/1/update', data={'title': 'updated title', 'body': 'updated body'})
assert r.status_code == 302
assert r.headers['Location'] == '/'

tests.name: test_update_post_unauthorized
preconditions: Post with id 1 exists and is authored by 'test'
actions: Send POST request to '/1/update' with valid title and body
tests.executable:
from flaskr import create_app
import tempfile, os
fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(); os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
client = app.test_client()
client.post('/auth/login', data={'username': 'other', 'password': 'other'})
r = client.post('/1/update', data={'title': 'unauthorized update', 'body': 'unauthorized body'})
assert r.status_code == 403

tests.name: test_update_post_empty_title
preconditions: Post with id 1 exists and is authored by 'test'
actions: Send POST request to '/1/update' with empty title and valid body
expected: Response contains 'Title is required.' error message
tests.executable:
from flaskr import create_app
import tempfile, os
fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(); os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
client = app.test_client()
client.post('/auth/login', data={'username': 'test', 'password': 'test'})
r = client.post('/1/update', data={'title': '', 'body': 'valid body'})
assert b'Title is required.' in r.data
